**Incremental review:** [Files changed](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7528/files) against `main`.

`NCCLAllGatherDispatcher.update_metadata()` (ragged / non-CG path) host-syncs the per-rank
token counts, then re-reads the device tensor for a total it already has on the host.

```python
cls._local_tokens_per_rank = local_tokens_per_rank.tolist()   # D2H sync #1
total = local_tokens_per_rank.sum()
_valid_tokens_tensor.copy_(total)
_host_valid_tokens_estimate = int(total.item())               # D2H sync #2, same data
```

`.item()` synchronises to read a value that `.tolist()` just copied to the host, and
`local_tokens` (the caller's Python int) is on the host too. The fix sums the host list
directly and writes the total with `.fill_`, which is the same write the original performed
via `copy_` after the reduction:

```python
cls._local_tokens_per_rank = local_tokens_per_rank.tolist()
total_tokens = sum(cls._local_tokens_per_rank)                # no sync
_valid_tokens_tensor.fill_(total_tokens)
_host_valid_tokens_estimate = total_tokens
```

## Measured effect

Deterministic, not a timing claim. `benchmarks/moe/ragged_sync_probe` counts the tensor
methods that force a device->host synchronisation by wrapping them, so base and patched are
compared on a number that does not depend on GPU contention. Configuration: EP=2,
local tokens `[2048, 128]`, 10 measured steps, exact-round-trip oracle enabled.

| tree | rank | syncs/step | `.tolist()` | `.item()` | round trip | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| base | 0 / 1 | **2.00** | 10 | 10 | exact | 2176 |
| patched | 0 / 1 | **1.00** | 10 | 0 | exact | 2176 |

`total` is the value the removed `.item()` used to produce: the probe asserts that the
valid-tokens tensor and the host estimate both equal the global token count
(`tensor=2176 host=2176 want=2176`), so the replacement writes exactly what the original did.
The exact round trip (`hidden * ep_size`) is unchanged.

## What this does NOT claim

**No wall-clock improvement.** Paired A/B (`-A-P-P-A-` style, same probe) on a shared node gave
**+43.5% / -0.3%** for this path across two run pairs -- opposite signs, i.e. below the noise
floor. The verifiable statement is one fewer device->host sync per ragged step; the time
saving on this hardware was not resolvable and is not asserted.

This is a draft: it removes a clearly redundant synchronisation, and whether that is worth
taking should be weighed against the fact that its runtime benefit could not be demonstrated.

## Regression

- `tests/unit_tests/inference/test_nccl_ragged_and_empty_rank.py`: 5 passed
- A3 token-count tests on a tree carrying both this change and the A3 fix: 11 passed, 3 skipped
  (identical to the A3 fix alone)

## Strict review: approved, with 3 suggestions

The code change is correct and is an exact refactor. The two new `benchmarks/` scripts are one-off verification tooling for this PR, and I suggest removing them before merge.

**Core change:** [`NCCLAllGatherDispatcher.update_metadata`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/65b68a4e5adc50c25f0786481ccafb051a0a60f2/megatron/core/transformer/moe/token_dispatcher_inference.py#L167-L178)

Old code ([base L171-L174](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c919b5e84e6fe096308bd9cc9d98697daa312921/megatron/core/transformer/moe/token_dispatcher_inference.py#L171-L174)):
- summed the int32 per-rank counts on the device;
- `copy_`'d the result into the int32 `_valid_tokens_tensor`;
- read it back with `.item()`.

New code:
- sums the host list that `.tolist()` already produced;
- writes it with `fill_`;
- stores the same Python int as `_host_valid_tokens_estimate`.

I traced the cases that matter:
- **Ragged EP>1:** same total.
- **A rank with 0 tokens:** `sum` gives the same value, and `max(tokens_per_rank)` is unaffected.
- **Stream ordering:** `fill_` and `copy_` are both enqueued on the current stream.
- **CUDA graphs:** the ragged branch is never captured.
- **CG path:** the `else` branch is unchanged.
- **`_local_tokens_per_rank` consumers:** `token_dispatch` and `token_combine` see no change.

This removes one device-to-host sync per ragged step without changing any value.

**Findings:** CRITICAL 0, IMPORTANT 0, SUGGESTION 3.

Most impactful (both repo hygiene, no runtime effect):
1. [`report_a2_verify.py`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/65b68a4e5adc50c25f0786481ccafb051a0a60f2/benchmarks/moe/ragged_sync_probe/report_a2_verify.py#L9) hardcodes a personal home-directory results path. On any other machine it prints nothing and exits 0.
2. The correctness checks in [`probe_a2_syncs.py`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/65b68a4e5adc50c25f0786481ccafb051a0a60f2/benchmarks/moe/ragged_sync_probe/probe_a2_syncs.py#L143-L145) only print on mismatch and never fail. No CI runs the script, so the repo gets no regression guard. I propose moving the valid-tokens assertion into the existing `TestNCCLAllGatherDispatcher::test_dispatch_combine`; the inline comment has the code.

The third is a comment in the core change that describes the removed code instead of the current code.

**Test coverage:** the PR description cites `tests/unit_tests/inference/test_nccl_ragged_and_empty_rank.py`, but that file is not in the head tree. The existing ragged-path test, [`test_dispatch_combine[True]`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/65b68a4e5adc50c25f0786481ccafb051a0a60f2/tests/unit_tests/inference/test_moe_dispatching_and_routing.py#L302-L366), checks the gathered and combined tensors. It does not check `_valid_tokens_tensor` or `_host_valid_tokens_estimate`, which are the values this PR touches. I checked equivalence by reading the code; I did not run anything.

**Overall risk: low.** The production change is a 3-line refactor of a non-captured prefill path, and I found no correctness, dtype, compatibility or performance problems. Approving under the strict rubric because nothing significant was found. The suggestions are non-blocking, but I recommend dropping `benchmarks/moe/ragged_sync_probe/` before merge.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.

- It runs at module level, with no `main()` or `__main__` guard.
- The `a2-verify-base/` and `a2-verify-patch/` directories it reads come from a launcher that is not in this PR.
- "A2" and "A3" are labels from the author's own workstream and mean nothing in the repo.

**Expected:** files committed to the repo can be reproduced from the repo.

**Correction (preferred):** delete `benchmarks/moe/ragged_sync_probe/report_a2_verify.py` from the PR. The base-vs-patch table is already in the PR description. If you keep it:
- take the results directory as a required `argparse` argument;
- wrap the loop in `main()` behind `if __name__ == "__main__":`;
- exit non-zero when no `rank*.jsonl` files match;
- add the NVIDIA copyright header that other repo Python files carry (`.github/workflows/copyright-check.yml` runs on PR branches).

**Preservation:** nothing in the repo imports or runs this file, so removing it affects nothing.

**Acceptance (static):** the file is gone from the diff. If kept instead, running it with no arguments prints argparse usage and exits non-zero, rather than printing nothing.

**[SUGGESTION Simplification]** The probe's correctness checks can't fail and nothing runs them. Please move the guard into the existing unit test.

**Failure:** the docstring (L11) says the oracle means "a lower count cannot come from skipping work", and the PR description says the probe "asserts" the valid-tokens total. In the code:
- A total mismatch at L143-145 only prints `TOTAL MISMATCH`.
- `exact` (L127) and `rows_ok` (L128) are only written to JSON.

So a tree that writes the wrong `_valid_tokens_tensor` still exits 0. The file also lives in a new top-level `benchmarks/` directory that no CI recipe runs, so it adds no regression guard for the changed lines in `update_metadata`.

Smaller issues if the file is kept:
- `NANOV3_BASE` (L80) is imported but never used.
- `_wrap` resets `_depth` to 0 before calling `_orig[name]` (L37-43), so it does not actually ignore internal re-entry as its docstring says.
- It has no NVIDIA copyright header.

**Correction (preferred):** drop `benchmarks/moe/ragged_sync_probe/`. Put the invariant in `tests/unit_tests/inference/test_moe_dispatching_and_routing.py::TestNCCLAllGatherDispatcher::test_dispatch_combine`, right after the multi-rank `d_hidden, d_probs = dispatcher.token_dispatch(hidden, probs)` (L353):

```python

            InferenceAllGatherDispatcherBase,
        )

        # update_metadata must publish the global token count on host and device.
        assert InferenceAllGatherDispatcherBase._host_valid_tokens_estimate == total_tokens
        assert int(InferenceAllGatherDispatcherBase._valid_tokens_tensor.item()) == total_tokens
```

Invariant: after `update_metadata`, `_valid_tokens_tensor[0] == _host_valid_tokens_estimate == sum(tokens_per_rank)`.

**Optional sync guard** for the ragged case only (proposed; add `monkeypatch` to the test's parameters):
- around the `token_dispatch` call only, wrap `torch.Tensor.item` with `monkeypatch.setattr` so it records each call and then calls the original;
- call `monkeypatch.undo()` before the `assert_close` checks;
- assert there were no `.item()` calls when `use_allgather_v=True`.

**Preservation:** both parametrizations must pass:
- `[False]`: the CG path. `total = ep_size * 16` from the unchanged `else` branch ([L179-182](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/65b68a4e5adc50c25f0786481ccafb051a0a60f2/megatron/core/transformer/moe/token_dispatcher_inference.py#L179-L182)).
- `[True]`: the ragged path, with `(r+1)*8` tokens per rank.

The `ep_size == 1` early return (L347-351) comes before the new asserts and is untouched. Keep the existing `assert_close` checks on `d_hidden`, `d_probs`, `routing_map` and `combined` unchanged.

**Acceptance (proposed, not executed):** with 2 or more ranks, `test_dispatch_combine[True]` and `[False]` pass on both base and head, because the value is unchanged. The optional `.item()` guard fails on base (1 call from the removed `total.item()`) and passes on head (0 calls).

+device->host transfer per ragged step. This probe counts them by wrapping the tensor

+import argparse

+_orig = {}
+_depth = {"sync": 0}
+call_log = []

+def _wrap(name):
+    """Wrap a tensor method so it records one sync event (ignoring internal re-entry)."""

+        inner = _depth["sync"] > 0

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=low -->

## Strict review: approved, with 3 suggestions

The code change is correct and is an exact refactor. The two new `benchmarks/` scripts are one-off verification tooling for this PR, and I suggest removing them before merge.

**Core change:** [`NCCLAllGatherDispatcher.update_metadata`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/65b68a4e5adc50c25f0786481ccafb051a0a60f2/megatron/core/transformer/moe/token_dispatcher_inference.py#L167-L178)

Old code ([base L171-L174](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c919b5e84e6fe096308bd9cc9d98697daa312921/megatron/core/transformer/moe/token_dispatcher_inference.py#L171-L174)):
- summed the int32 per-rank counts on the device;
- `copy_`'d the result into the int32 `_valid_tokens_tensor`;
- read it back with `.item()`.

New code:
- sums the host list that `.tolist()` already produced;
- writes it with `fill_`;
- stores the same Python int as `_host_valid_tokens_estimate`.

I traced the cases that matter:
- **Ragged EP>1:** same total.
- **A rank with 0 tokens:** `sum` gives the same value, and `max(tokens_per_rank)` is unaffected.
- **Stream ordering:** `fill_` and `copy_` are both enqueued on the current stream.
- **CUDA graphs:** the ragged branch is never captured.
- **CG path:** the `else` branch is unchanged.
- **`_local_tokens_per_rank` consumers:** `token_dispatch` and `token_combine` see no change.

This removes one device-to-host sync per ragged step without changing any value.

**Findings:** CRITICAL 0, IMPORTANT 0, SUGGESTION 3.

Most impactful (both repo hygiene, no runtime effect):
1. [`report_a2_verify.py`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/65b68a4e5adc50c25f0786481ccafb051a0a60f2/benchmarks/moe/ragged_sync_probe/report_a2_verify.py#L9) hardcodes a personal home-directory results path. On any other machine it prints nothing and exits 0.
2. The correctness checks in [`probe_a2_syncs.py`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/65b68a4e5adc50c25f0786481ccafb051a0a60f2/benchmarks/moe/ragged_sync_probe/probe_a2_syncs.py#L143-L145) only print on mismatch and never fail. No CI runs the script, so the repo gets no regression guard. I propose moving the valid-tokens assertion into the existing `TestNCCLAllGatherDispatcher::test_dispatch_combine`; the inline comment has the code.

The third is a comment in the core change that describes the removed code instead of the current code.

**Test coverage:** the PR description cites `tests/unit_tests/inference/test_nccl_ragged_and_empty_rank.py`, but that file is not in the head tree. The existing ragged-path test, [`test_dispatch_combine[True]`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/65b68a4e5adc50c25f0786481ccafb051a0a60f2/tests/unit_tests/inference/test_moe_dispatching_and_routing.py#L302-L366), checks the gathered and combined tensors. It does not check `_valid_tokens_tensor` or `_host_valid_tokens_estimate`, which are the values this PR touches. I checked equivalence by reading the code; I did not run anything.

**Overall risk: low.** The production change is a 3-line refactor of a non-captured prefill path, and I found no correctness, dtype, compatibility or performance problems. Approving under the strict rubric because nothing significant was found. The suggestions are non-blocking, but I recommend dropping `benchmarks/moe/ragged_sync_probe/` before merge.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.
